title: Protection Against Nazar (Evil Eye) & Negative Energy
description: It is strongly recommended to recite Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas 3 times each morning and evening, then blow over oneself and one's children. This provides spiritual protection against envy, jealousy, malicious gazes, and sorcery.
spiritualGoal: Protection against envy and negative energy
body: It is strongly recommended to recite Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas 3 times each morning and evening, then blow over oneself and one's children. This provides spiritual protection against envy, jealousy, malicious gazes, and sorcery.
urduText: نظربد سے بچاؤ کے لیے سورہ الفلق اور سورہ الناس کی تلاوت روزانہ کریں۔

title: Congregational Prayer (Namaz in Jama’at) & Home Jama’at
description: It is obligatory to always perform the five daily prayers in congregation (Jama’at). If one cannot attend the mosque for valid Islamic legal (Shar’i) reasons, arrange Jama’at at home with the family.
spiritualGoal: Sustaining collective worship and barakah at home
body: It is obligatory to always perform the five daily prayers in congregation (Jama’at). If one cannot attend the mosque for valid Islamic legal (Shar’i) reasons, arrange Jama’at at home with the family.
urduText: نماز باجماعت ادا کرنی ہے ہمیشہ، اور اگر مسجد نہ ہو تو گھر میں جماعت قائم کریں۔

title: Remaining in Continuous Wudu (Ablution) & Nightly Prayer Answer
description: Maintain a state of purity (Wudu) at all times. Sleeping in Wudu protects against demonic forces. If you wake up during the night, renew your Wudu before making Du’a. This guarantees that your prayer is answered or replaced with something better.
spiritualGoal: Uninterrupted divine connection and guaranteed supplication response
body: Maintain a state of purity (Wudu) at all times. Sleeping in Wudu protects against demonic forces. If you wake up during the night, renew your Wudu before making Du’a. This guarantees that your prayer is answered or replaced with something better.
urduText: ہر وقت باوضو رہنا ضروری ہے، اور رات کو سونے سے پہلے وضو کر کے سوئیں۔

title: Khar-i-Anfas (Pas-i-Anfas): Breathing Technique with Kalima Tayyiba
description: Connect Dhikr directly to your breath: Recite "La ilaha illallah" upon inhaling, and "Muhammadur Rasulullah" upon exhaling. This automatically dispels dark forces, magic, and demons while kindling spiritual fire in the heart.
spiritualGoal: Burn away negative entities and ignite the heart's spiritual light
body: Connect Dhikr directly to your breath: Recite "La ilaha illallah" upon inhaling, and "Muhammadur Rasulullah" upon exhaling. This automatically dispels dark forces, magic, and demons while kindling spiritual fire in the heart.
urduText: سانس کے ساتھ ذکر کو جوڑیں: لا الہ الا اللہ (انہیل) محمد الرسول اللہ (ایکزیل)۔

title: Tasleem-o-Raza & True Istikhara Intuition
description: True Istikhara is not merely relying on visual dreams, but receiving transparent inner heart guidance and certainty from Allah. Submitting fully to Allah's divine decree (Tasleem-o-Raza) brings immediate spiritual breakthroughs.
spiritualGoal: Inner spiritual certainty and divine alignment
body: True Istikhara is not merely relying on visual dreams, but receiving transparent inner heart guidance and certainty from Allah. Submitting fully to Allah's divine decree (Tasleem-o-Raza) brings immediate spiritual breakthroughs.
urduText: تسلیم و رضا اور سچی استخارہ دل کی باطنی بصیرت ہے، صرف خواب نہیں۔

title: Finger Grip Technique for Exorcism & Demonic Possession
description: When treating a person affected by evil spirits or demonic possession, grip and press their finger firmly. As the dark entity leaves the patient's body, the healer experiences a physical sensation like a fine thread or strand sliding out of their hand.
spiritualGoal: Safely purging evil spirits from possessed individuals
body: When treating a person affected by evil spirits or demonic possession, grip and press their finger firmly. As the dark entity leaves the patient's body, the healer experiences a physical sensation like a fine thread or strand sliding out of their hand.
urduText: مریض کی انگلی کو مضبوطی سے پکڑ کر دبائیں، جب ہوائی چیز نکلے گی تو ہاتھ سے دھاگا نکلنے جیسا احساس ہوگا۔

title: Saturated Salt Water Solution for Spiritual Obstacles & Unblocking Affairs
description: Add approximately 250g of natural rock salt or sea salt to water until it forms a saturated solution. Using or sprinkling this water cleanses spiritual blockages, drives away evil forces, and unblocks stalled work or business tasks.
spiritualGoal: Removing invisible obstacles and restoring progress in life
body: Add approximately 250g of natural rock salt or sea salt to water until it forms a saturated solution. Using or sprinkling this water cleanses spiritual blockages, drives away evil forces, and unblocks stalled work or business tasks.
urduText: پانی میں دیسی نمک یا سمندری نمک ڈال کر گاڑھا (Saturated) گھول بنائیں، ہوائی چیزوں اور کام کی رکاوٹوں کے لیے مفید ہے۔

title: Nazar (Evil Eye) Symptoms in Children & Exorcism Precautions
description: Severe evil eye (Nazar) causes infants and young children to cry relentlessly, fall sick, and sink into dark depression. When performing Dam, exercise extreme caution: never perform Dam or touch the head if another spiritual healer is actively working on the patient.
spiritualGoal: Protecting children from envy and ensuring safe spiritual treatment
body: Severe evil eye (Nazar) causes infants and young children to cry relentlessly, fall sick, and sink into dark depression. When performing Dam, exercise extreme caution: never perform Dam or touch the head if another spiritual healer is actively working on the patient.
urduText: نظربد سے بچہ روتا ہے، بیمار اور ڈپریشن میں جاتا ہے۔ اگر کوئی اور دم کر رہا ہو تو خود ہاتھ نہ لگائیں۔

title: Eliminating Anger & Divine Connection (Pure Heart)
description: Anger and despair are weapons from Shaytan. Filling the heart with pure divine love drives away illness. Everything in the universe stems from attaching oneself to Allah and His Messenger (pbuh).
spiritualGoal: Purifying the heart to naturally dispel diseases
body: Anger and despair are weapons from Shaytan. Filling the heart with pure divine love drives away illness. Everything in the universe stems from attaching oneself to Allah and His Messenger (pbuh).
urduText: دل کو محبت سے بھریں اور غصہ نکالیں کیونکہ غصہ شیطان کی طرف سے ہے، دل پاک ہو تو بیماریاں بھاگ جاتی ہیں۔
